create.name: Raja Choudhury
create.bio:
Raja Choudhury, whom his students call Rajada, teaches Kundalini Shakti, Tantra and Kriya Yoga and makes documentary films. After training as an architect at the Architectural Association in London, he worked in London and New York as a digital creative director, and in 2006 a Kundalini awakening turned his life in a new direction. Moving to India, he made films about spiritual teachers and wisdom traditions, among them one on his teacher, Guruji Amritananda, and Spirituality in the Modern World, featuring Ken Wilber. The Quantum Indians received India's National Film Award in 2014, PBS broadcast America's First Guru, about Swami Vivekananda, and in 2012 he gave a TED talk on Indian wisdom.

His teaching draws on Shaiva and Shakta Tantra, Sri Vidya, the Vigyan Bhairav Tantra and Vedanta, set beside modern psychology and neuroscience, with breath, mantra and meditation at the core, and he encourages students to be their own guru. He teaches online on The Shift Network and runs A Thousand Suns Academy, which offers a monthly membership, The Path, along with on-demand programmes. His lengthy talks on Shiva, Kundalini and the third eye draw large audiences on YouTube. He lives in Princeton, New Jersey.

courses.title: Awakening Your Kundalini
courses.description: A seven-module on-demand Shift Network course, each session two hours long. Raja introduces Kundalini energy and works up through the chakras towards the heart and third eye with breath, mantra and grounding practices.

courses.title: Advanced Kundalini Awakening
courses.description: A 21-part self-paced Shift Network training that goes deeper into Kundalini practice. It covers prana and the nadis, the Sri Chakra yantra, Sri Vidya and the Maha Vidyas, with breath, mantra and meditation in each session.

courses.title: The Dance of Shiva & Shakti
courses.description: A twelve-module on-demand Shift Network course on the meditations of the Vigyan Bhairav Tantra. Each session has about 90 minutes of teaching and questions followed by a guided meditation using breath, the senses and visualisation.

courses.title: The Inner Goddess Activation
courses.description: A nine-module recorded Shift Network course on Shakti, the divine feminine, as understood in Shaktism and Tantra. It explores goddess archetypes through mantra, yantra, mudra, breath and sound.

courses.title: Ancient Secrets for Clearing Karma
courses.description: A nine-module recorded Shift Network course using breathwork, mantra, mudra and visualisation from Tantra and Kriya Yoga. The theme is releasing old patterns and karmic weight.

courses.title: Awaken Your Inner Freedom
courses.description: A self-paced Shift Network course on the teachings of Swami Vivekananda, including Vedanta and the four paths of yoga. It looks at self-realisation, inner peace and service, and includes streaming access to Raja's film America's First Guru.

courses.title: The Kundalini Shakti Code
courses.description: A seven-module on-demand programme from A Thousand Suns Academy, focused on Kundalini Shakti and three goddesses: Chandi, Siddha Lakshmi and Tripura Sundari. It is Raja's foundational course and the prerequisite for his advanced trainings.

courses.title: Just Shreem!
courses.description: A nine-session on-demand programme on the Tantric teachings of the goddess Lakshmi. It follows a seven-step path built around desire, intention and the mantra Shreem.

courses.title: The Path membership
courses.description: A twelve-month membership of A Thousand Suns Academy with live advanced classes two or three times a month and a monthly satsang. Members also get a library of more than 160 recorded classes on Shiva, Shakti, Tantra, Sri Vidya, Vedanta and sacred sound.
courses.price: $45 USD per month or $450 USD per year

free_resources.title: Three free initiate classes
free_resources.description: Three recorded classes from Raja's membership, The Path, sent free in return for a name and email: The Chandi Path, The Tantra of Manifestation and a third class on spiritual practice. A simple way to sample his teaching before joining a course.

flags: Public name: the Shift lists him as 'Rajada (Raja Choudhury)'; the listing uses Raja Choudhury, with Rajada mentioned in the bio — change if you would rather lead with Rajada.
Email raja@athousandsunsacademy.com is published on The Path page (for scholarship requests); info@athousandsunsacademy.com is also published in the academy's privacy policy.
The Path price: the membership page says $45/month or $450/year, but the academy's events calendar says $7 for the first month then $27/month; I used the membership page figures.

Several of his Shift course pages carry 'ended'/'closed' tags in their metadata although they show a Register button and are listed as current self-paced programmes on his Shift profile; prices were read from those pages.

The Shift pages for Inner Goddess Activation and Clearing Karma mention depression, trauma, disease and pain in their module copy; titles and my descriptions are clean, but a human may prefer to drop them.
The free initiate classes are a sign-up gift (email needed); one of the three is called 'The Tantra of Healing' and was not named in the description.
The top video's title includes 'FULL TALK OVER 1.6 MILLION VIEWS'; copied as published, trim if wanted.
left_out: Shift: Advanced Kundalini Shakti Initiation (2020) and Awakening Your Kundalini Advanced Program (2019) — older runs of the advanced course, tagged ended/closed; the current Advanced Kundalini Awakening is listed instead. Their pages also name headaches, dizziness and anxiety.
